source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 16 (PDF 61-84), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Electrostatics / Static Electricity) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define electric potential difference and its SI unit. Write the relation between electric field and potential difference, explain the meaning of its negative sign, and obtain the form it takes for a uniform field. (5 marks)
(Electric potential difference aur us ki SI unit ki definition likhein. Electric field aur potential difference ka taluq likhein, us ke negative nishan ka matlab samjhayein, aur uniform field ke liye us ki shakal nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Do points ke darmiyan electric potential difference woh kaam hai jo fi unit charge, charge ko un ke darmiyan le jane mein hota hai. Agar test charge q₀ ko uniform field mein A se B le jayein (Fig. 16.1):
V = V_B − V_A = W_AB/q₀ = ΔU/q₀ ... (16.1)

Unit: SI unit volt hai: 1 V = 1 J/1 C ... (16.2). Ise kilovolt ya millivolt mein badla ja sakta hai.

Electric field se taluq: field mein faasle ke saath potential badalta hai:
ΔV = −E Δd ... (16.3)
is liye electric field faasle ke saath potential ki tabdeeli ki sharah ka negative hai:
E = −ΔV/Δd ... (16.4)

Negative nishan: batata hai ke field zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf hoti hai; field ki simt mein potential kam hota hai.

Uniform field: d faasle par do plates jin ka potential difference V ho, un ke darmiyan
E = V/d ... (16.5)
Yani potential difference field ki taqat aur faasle dono ke seedha mutanasib hai; taqatwar field mein potential tezi se girta hai.

book_ref.quote: The electric potential difference is the work done per unit charge in moving a charge between two points

blocks.prompt:
2 Two parallel plates 0.8 cm apart are connected to a 24 V battery. Find (i) the electric field between the plates, (ii) the force on a charge of 5 μC placed between them, and (iii) the work done in moving this charge from one plate to the other. (3 marks)
(0.8 cm door do parallel plates 24 V battery se jori gayi hain. Nikalein: (i) plates ke darmiyan electric field, (ii) un ke darmiyan rakhe 5 μC charge par force, aur (iii) is charge ko aik plate se doosri tak le jane ka kaam.)
blocks.explanation: Uniform field ke liye E = V/d, F = qE aur potential difference ki definition se W = qV lagayein.

book_ref.quote: In the case of a uniform electric field, this relation simplifies to:

blocks.prompt:
3 Define electric potential at a point. Derive an expression for the electric potential at a distance r from a positive point charge q. (5 marks)
(Kisi point par electric potential ki definition likhein. Positive point charge q se r faasle par electric potential ka formula derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Electric field mein kisi point par electric potential woh kaam hai jo unit positive charge ko infinity se us point tak electrostatic equilibrium mein lane mein hota hai. V = W/q₀ ... (16.6). Yeh scalar hai.

Derivation: ΔV = −E Δr ke liye E sabit chahiye, lekin point charge ki field radial hai aur E ∝ 1/r². Is liye do bohat qareeb points A aur B lein jo q se r_A aur r_B faasle par hain (Fig. 16.2), taake un ke darmiyan E taqreeban sabit rahe:
r_B = r_A + Δr ... (16.7), Δr = r_B − r_A ... (16.8)
AB ka darmiyani point r = (r_A + r_B)/2 ... (16.9) par hai, jahan
E = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²) ... (16.10)
A aur B bohat qareeb hain, is liye arithmetic mean = geometric mean:
r² = r_A r_B ... (16.11)
E = (1/4πε₀)(q/r_A r_B) ... (16.12)
Unit positive charge ko B se A le jane ka kaam potential difference ke barabar hai:
V_A − V_B = −E(r_A − r_B) = E(r_B − r_A) ... (16.13)
(16.12) se E rakhein:
V_A − V_B = (q/4πε₀)((r_B − r_A)/(r_A r_B)) ... (16.14)
V_A − V_B = (q/4πε₀)(1/r_A − 1/r_B) ... (16.15)

Absolute potential: B ko infinity par lein, V_B = 0 aur 1/r_B = 0:
V_A = (1/4πε₀)(q/r_A) ... (16.16)
Aam tor par r faasle par: V_r = (1/4πε₀)(q/r) ... (16.17)
Negative charge ka potential negative hota hai; kayi charges ka kul potential un ke potentials ka algebraic jama hai.

book_ref.quote: Let us take two points A and B, infinitesimally close to each other, so that E remains almost constant between them.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein (16.14) aur (16.15) mein charge q chhap nahi saka (Book correction); yahan q ke saath durust likha gaya hai. Bunyadi chaal: chhote se faasle par E ko sabit maan lo, r² = r_A r_B le lo, phir B ko infinity par le jao.

blocks.prompt:
4 Point charges of +4 nC and −6 nC are placed 50 cm apart. Find (i) the electric potential at the midpoint of the line joining them, and (ii) the point between them where the potential is zero. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²) (3 marks)
(+4 nC aur −6 nC point charges 50 cm door rakhe hain. Nikalein: (i) un ko milane wali line ke darmiyani point par electric potential, aur (ii) un ke darmiyan woh point jahan potential sifar hai. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))
blocks.explanation: Potential scalar hai: dono potentials nishan ke saath jama karein; zero point ke liye dono ki miqdaar barabar rakhein.

book_ref.quote: the total electric potential is the algebraic sum of the individual potentials created by all the charges

steps: Darmiyani point: har charge se r = 0.25 m; V = (9 × 10⁹)(4 × 10⁻⁹ − 6 × 10⁻⁹)/0.25 = −72 V
+4 nC se x par zero point: 4/x = 6/(50 − x)
4(50 − x) = 6x → 200 = 10x → x = 20 cm (+4 nC se), yani −6 nC se 30 cm
blocks.final_answer: (i) V = −72 V; (ii) +4 nC charge se 20 cm

blocks.prompt:
5 Derive an expression for the electric potential energy of a system of two point charges Q and q separated by a distance r. (5 marks)
(r faasle par do point charges Q aur q ke system ki electric potential energy ka formula derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Do points A aur B lein jo r faasle par hain (Fig. 16.4) aur shuru mein wahan koi electric field nahi.

Qadam 1: charge Q ko infinity se A tak layein. A par field nahi, is liye koi rukawat nahi:
W_A = 0 ... (16.19)

Qadam 2: A par Q, B par potential banata hai:
V = (1/4πε₀)(Q/r) ... (16.20)
Ab doosra charge q infinity se B tak layein. Q ki field ke khilaf kaam hota hai:
W_B = q × (electric potential) = qV ... (16.21)
W_B = q(1/4πε₀)(Q/r) = (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r) ... (16.22)

Kul kaam: W = W_A + W_B = 0 + (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r)
W = (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r) ... (16.23)

Yeh kaam system mein electric potential energy ki shakal mein store hota hai:
E_p = (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r) ... (16.24)
E_p joule mein hai; yeh faasle r ke ulat mutanasib hai.

book_ref.quote: The concept of electric potential directly leads to the expression for electric potential energy of two point charges

blocks.prompt:
6 Two point charges of +5 μC and +2 μC are 30 cm apart. Find (i) their electric potential energy, and (ii) the work needed to bring them to 10 cm apart. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²) (3 marks)
(+5 μC aur +2 μC ke do point charges 30 cm door hain. Nikalein: (i) un ki electric potential energy, aur (ii) unhein 10 cm tak qareeb lane ke liye darkar kaam. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))
blocks.explanation: Dono faaslon par E_p = (1/4πε₀)(Qq/r) nikalein; darkar kaam potential energy ka izafa hai.

book_ref.quote: Two point charges are separated by a distance of 4.0 cm.

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain the motion of positive and negative charges released in an electric field. Show that a charge q₀ of mass m falling through a potential difference ΔV gains speed given by ½mv² = q₀ΔV, and define the electron-volt. (5 marks)
(Electric field mein chhore gaye positive aur negative charges ki harkat samjhayein. Dikhayein ke m mass wala charge q₀ potential difference ΔV se guzar kar ½mv² = q₀ΔV ke mutabiq raftaar hasil karta hai, aur electron-volt ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Harkat: Agar charge q₀ ko charge q ki field mein azad chhora jaye to yeh door dhakela jata hai. Eq. (16.17) ke mutabiq faasle ke saath potential kam hota hai. Is liye azad positive charge hamesha zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf accelerate karta hai. Azad negative charge kam se zyada potential ki taraf jata hai.

Energy: Agar do points ka potential difference ΔV ho to charge ki potential energy kam hoti hai:
ΔU = q₀ΔV
Yeh kami kinetic energy ban jati hai. m mass ka jism sukoon se chal kar velocity v se pohanche to:
½mv² = q₀ΔV ... (16.18)
yani v = √(2q₀ΔV/m).

Electron-volt: Eq. (16.18) batati hai ke energy charge × potential difference bhi likhi ja sakti hai. Aik electron-volt woh energy hai jo electron 1 volt potential difference se accelerate ho kar hasil karta hai:
1 eV = electron ka charge × 1 volt = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J
Yeh atomic physics mein energy ki unit hai.

book_ref.quote: This decrease in potential energy of the charge will appear as its kinetic energy.

blocks.prompt:
8 A particle of mass 1.0 × 10⁻⁸ kg carrying a charge of 4 μC starts from rest and is accelerated through 50 V. Find (i) its kinetic energy, and (ii) its final speed. (iii) What energy, in eV and in joules, would an electron gain through the same 50 V? (3 marks)
(1.0 × 10⁻⁸ kg mass aur 4 μC charge wala zarra sukoon se 50 V ke zariye accelerate hota hai. Nikalein: (i) us ki kinetic energy, (ii) aakhri raftaar. (iii) Isi 50 V se electron kitni energy (eV aur joule mein) hasil karega?)
blocks.explanation: Potential energy ki kami q₀ΔV kinetic energy ½mv² ban jati hai.

book_ref.quote: the body will reach the point at lower potential energy with velocity v

blocks.prompt:
9 What is an isolated spherical conductor? Define its capacitance and the farad, and derive an expression for the capacitance of an isolated sphere of radius R. On what does it depend? (5 marks)
(Isolated spherical conductor kya hai? Is ki capacitance aur farad ki definition likhein, aur R radius wale isolated sphere ki capacitance ka formula derive karein. Yeh kin cheezon par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Isolated spherical conductor: aisa spherical conductor jo doosre conductors ya asar se door fiza mein rakha ho. Is ki charge store karne ki salahiyat capacitance C hai.

Definition: isolated spherical conductor ki capacitance sphere par jama charge fi unit surface potential hai:
C = Q/V ... (16.25)
SI unit: farad (F). Sphere ke liye 1 farad us sphere ki capacitance hai jo 1 volt potential par 1 coulomb store kare (khali fiza mein): 1 F = 1 C/1 V.

Derivation: charge Q bairooni surface par hota hai. R radius wale sphere ki surface par potential
V = (1/4πε₀)(Q/R)
(16.25) mein rakhein:
C = Q/[(1/4πε₀)(Q/R)]
C = 4πε₀R ... (16.26)
εᵣ dielectric constant wale medium mein:
C = 4πε₀εᵣR ... (16.27)

Inhisaar: C charge ya potential par munhasir nahi; sphere ke radius aur medium par munhasir hai. Radius barhne se C barhti hai, yani bara sphere usi potential par zyada charge rakhta hai; dielectric medium bhi C barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: defined as the electric charge stored on the sphere per unit electric potential at its surface

blocks.prompt:
10 An isolated metal sphere of radius 27 cm is in air. Find (i) its capacitance, (ii) the charge needed to raise its surface potential to 6000 V, and (iii) its capacitance in a medium of dielectric constant 2.5. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²) (3 marks)
(27 cm radius wala isolated metal sphere hawa mein hai. Nikalein: (i) us ki capacitance, (ii) surface potential 6000 V karne ke liye darkar charge, aur (iii) 2.5 dielectric constant wale medium mein capacitance. (1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))
blocks.explanation: C = 4πε₀R = R/(9 × 10⁹), phir Q = CV, phir C ko εᵣ se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: The capacitance increases with increase in radius of the sphere.

blocks.prompt:
11 Define the capacitance of a capacitor. Derive an expression for the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor (i) with vacuum and (ii) with a dielectric of relative permittivity εᵣ between its plates. (5 marks)
(Capacitor ki capacitance ki definition likhein. Parallel plate capacitor ki capacitance ka formula derive karein jab plates ke darmiyan (i) vacuum ho aur (ii) εᵣ relative permittivity wala dielectric ho.)
blocks.explanation:
Capacitance: capacitor ko V volt ki battery se jorne par plates par +Q aur −Q aata hai, aur Q ∝ V:
Q = CV ya C = Q/V ... (16.28)
Capacitance woh charge hai jo aik plate par us ka potential doosri ke muqable aik volt barhane ke liye chahiye. Unit: farad (coulomb fi volt).

Derivation (vacuum): do parallel metal plates, har aik ka area A, chhote faasle d par (Fig. 16.6), taake darmiyan field E uniform aur plates ke darmiyan mehdood rahe.
C_vac = Q/V ... (16.29)
Uniform field ke liye: E = V/d ... (16.30)
Gauss's law se E = σ/ε₀, aur surface charge density σ = Q/A, is liye
E = Q/(Aε₀) ... (16.31)
(16.30) aur (16.31) se: V/d = Q/(Aε₀), yani Q/V = Aε₀/d
C_vac = Q/V = Aε₀/d ... (16.32)

Dielectric ke saath: plates ke darmiyan εᵣ wala insulator capacitance ko εᵣ guna kar deta hai:
C_med = Aε₀εᵣ/d ... (16.33)
Yani capacitance plates ke area A, faasle d aur darmiyani medium (εᵣ) par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: The distance d is small so that the electric field E between the plates is uniform

blocks.prompt:
12 A parallel plate capacitor has square plates of side 10 cm separated by 0.2 mm of a dielectric of εᵣ = 6. Find (i) its capacitance, and (ii) the charge on each plate when it is connected to a 50 V supply. (Take ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻².) (3 marks)
(Parallel plate capacitor ki murabba plates ki side 10 cm hai aur un ke darmiyan εᵣ = 6 wala 0.2 mm dielectric hai. Nikalein: (i) capacitance, aur (ii) 50 V supply se jorne par har plate par charge. (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻² lein.))
blocks.explanation: Plate ka area nikalein, C_med = Aε₀εᵣ/d lagayein, phir Q = CV.

book_ref.quote: the capacitance of capacitor is enhanced by the factor

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe an experiment showing the effect of inserting a dielectric between the plates of a charged capacitor. Define the dielectric constant and explain, in terms of polarization, why the potential difference between the plates decreases. (5 marks)
(Charged capacitor ki plates mein dielectric dalne ka asar dikhane wala tajruba bayan karein. Dielectric constant ki definition likhein aur polarization ke zariye samjhayein ke plates ka potential difference kyun kam hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Tajruba (Fig. 16.7): charged capacitor voltmeter se jora jata hai; is ki deflection plates ka potential difference batati hai. Plates mein dielectric dalne par reading gir jati hai, yani V kam hota hai. C = Q/V aur Q sabit hai, is liye C barhti hai:
C_med = Aε₀εᵣ/d ... (16.33)

Dielectric constant: (16.33) ko C_vac = Aε₀/d (16.32) se taqseem karein:
εᵣ = C_med/C_vac ... (16.34)
Yeh parallel plate capacitor ki plates ke darmiyan insulator ke saath capacitance aur vacuum (ya hawa) ke saath capacitance ki nisbat hai.

Polarization: dielectric insulator hai jis mein azad electrons nahi; sab electrons nuclei se bandhe hain. Electric field mein har atom ke electrons nucleus ke muqable field ke ulat thora khisak jate hain (Fig. 16.7 c). Ise dielectric ka polarization kehte hain; atom polarized ho jata hai.

V kyun kam hota hai: charged plates ke darmiyan slab ke atoms field se polarized hote hain (Fig. 16.7 d). Plates ko chhoone wali satahon par charges aate hain jin ka nishan saath wali plate ke ulat hota hai. Is se asar mein plates ka charge kam hota hai, is liye plates ke darmiyan electric intensity aur potential difference kam ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The reason for decrease in potential difference between the plates of the capacitor is the polarization of the atoms

blocks.prompt:
14 A 40 pF air capacitor is charged to 200 V and disconnected from the battery. When a dielectric slab fills the space between the plates, the voltmeter reading falls to 50 V. Find (i) the charge on the plates, (ii) the new capacitance, and (iii) the dielectric constant of the slab. (3 marks)
(40 pF hawa wala capacitor 200 V tak charge kar ke battery se alag kar diya gaya. Plates ke darmiyan dielectric slab bharne par voltmeter ki reading 50 V reh gayi. Nikalein: (i) plates par charge, (ii) nayi capacitance, aur (iii) slab ka dielectric constant.)
blocks.explanation: Capacitor alag hai, is liye Q sabit rehta hai; nayi C = Q/V aur εᵣ = C_med/C_vac.

book_ref.quote: since V decreases while Q remains constant, the value of C increases

blocks.prompt:
15 What is meant by combination of capacitors? Explain the parallel combination of three capacitors and derive the formula for their equivalent capacitance. (5 marks)
(Capacitors ke combination se kya muraad hai? Teen capacitors ka parallel combination samjhayein aur un ki equivalent capacitance ka formula derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Combination: jab matlooba capacitance hasil karne ke liye aik se zyada capacitors circuit mein jore jayein to yeh combination hai; yeh aik equivalent capacitor ki tarah kaam karta hai. Do aam qismein: parallel aur series.

Parallel combination (Fig. 16.8): tamam capacitors ki aik taraf ki plates battery ke negative terminal se aur doosri taraf ki plates positive terminal se jori jati hain.
(i) Har capacitor par potential difference V aik jaisa hai.
(ii) Har aik par charge us ki capacitance ke mutabiq mukhtalif hai: C₁, C₂, C₃ par Q₁, Q₂, Q₃.

Derivation: equivalent capacitor C_e usi V par utna hi kul charge rakhta hai:
Q = Q₁ + Q₂ + Q₃
Q₁ = C₁V, Q₂ = C₂V, Q₃ = C₃V aur Q = C_eV rakhein:
C_eV = C₁V + C₂V + C₃V
C_e = C₁ + C₂ + C₃ ... (16.35)

Nateeja: parallel mein jure capacitors ki mushtarka capacitance un ki alag alag capacitances ke jama ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: In this combination the potential difference V across the plates of each capacitor is the same.

blocks.prompt:
16 Capacitors of 2 μF, 4 μF and 6 μF are connected in parallel across a 15 V battery. Find (i) the equivalent capacitance, (ii) the charge on each capacitor, and (iii) the total charge. (3 marks)
(2 μF, 4 μF aur 6 μF capacitors 15 V battery ke saath parallel mein hain. Nikalein: (i) equivalent capacitance, (ii) har capacitor par charge, aur (iii) kul charge.)
blocks.explanation: Parallel mein har capacitor par poore 15 V hain; capacitances jama karein aur har aik ke liye Q = CV lagayein.

book_ref.quote: The charge on each will be different depending upon its capacitance.

blocks.prompt:
17 Explain the series combination of three capacitors. Show that each capacitor carries the same charge and derive the formula for their equivalent capacitance. (5 marks)
(Teen capacitors ka series combination samjhayein. Dikhayein ke har capacitor par aik jaisa charge hota hai aur equivalent capacitance ka formula derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tarteeb (Fig. 16.9): capacitors aik ke baad aik line mein jore jate hain. C₁ ki doosri plate C₂ ki pehli plate se, C₂ ki doosri plate C₃ ki pehli plate se juri hai; C₁ ki pehli aur C₃ ki doosri plate battery se juri hain.

Aik jaisa charge: battery C₁ ki pehli plate ko +Q deti hai. C₁ ki doosri plate pehli se insulated hai, battery se charge nahi le sakti, lekin +Q us par barabar −Q induce karta hai. Phir us se juri C₂ ki pehli plate par +Q aa jata hai, aur isi tarah C₃. Yani har capacitor ki har plate par Q miqdaar ka charge hai.

Voltages: combination par kul potential difference battery ke V ke barabar hai, lekin capacitance ke mutabiq taqseem hota hai:
V = V₁ + V₂ + V₃ ... (16.36)

Derivation: equivalent capacitor C_e par bhi Q aur V hai. V = Q/C se:
V = Q/C_e, V₁ = Q/C₁, V₂ = Q/C₂, V₃ = Q/C₃
(16.36) mein rakhein: Q/C_e = Q/C₁ + Q/C₂ + Q/C₃
1/C_e = 1/C₁ + 1/C₂ + 1/C₃ ... (16.37)

Nateeja: equivalent capacitance ka reciprocal alag alag capacitances ke reciprocals ke jama ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus each capacitor receives a charge of magnitude Q on each of its plates.

blocks.prompt:
18 Capacitors of 4 μF, 6 μF and 12 μF are connected in series across a 60 V battery. Find (i) the equivalent capacitance, (ii) the charge on each capacitor, and (iii) the potential difference across each. (3 marks)
(4 μF, 6 μF aur 12 μF capacitors 60 V battery ke saath series mein hain. Nikalein: (i) equivalent capacitance, (ii) har capacitor par charge, aur (iii) har aik par potential difference.)
blocks.explanation: C_e ke liye reciprocals jama karein; har aik par aik hi charge Q = C_eV; phir har aik ke liye V = Q/C.

book_ref.quote: In series combination charge on each capacitor will be the same Q.

blocks.final_answer: (i) 2 μF; (ii) har aik par 120 μC = 1.2 × 10⁻⁴ C; (iii) 30 V, 20 V, 10 V

blocks.prompt:
19 Explain why a charged capacitor possesses energy. Using the potential-charge graph, show that the energy stored in a capacitor is ½QV, and express it in terms of C and V. (5 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke charged capacitor mein energy kyun hoti hai. Potential-charge graph ki madad se sabit karein ke capacitor mein store energy ½QV hai, aur ise C aur V ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Energy kyun: plates par charge jama karne mein kaam hota hai jo electrical potential energy ki shakal mein store hota hai. Saboot: charged capacitor ki plates moti taar se jorne par charge bahta hai aur taar garam ho jati hai; yeh hararat wohi energy hai jo capacitor mein thi.

Graph: Q ∝ V, is liye V vs Q graph origin se guzarti seedhi line hai (Fig. 16.10). Har chhote charge ke izafe se potential difference barhta hai, is liye agle hisse ke liye zyada kaam chahiye.

Derivation: graph ke neeche area ko chhote charge hisson ΔQ mein baantein. ΔQ ko plates ke potential difference V₁ se guzarne ka kaam
ΔW = (ΔQ)(V₁) ... (16.38)
jo graph ke neeche patle rectangle ka area hai. Capacitor ko Q tak charge karne ka kul kaam in sab rectangles ka jama, yani graph ke neeche ka poora area, qaima zaviya tikon OAB hai:
Tikon OAB ka area = ½(base)(height) = ½(OA)(AB)
OA = Q (kul charge) aur AB = V (aakhri potential difference):
Store energy, W = ½QV ... (16.39)

C aur V ki shakal mein: Q = CV rakhein:
W = ½(CV)V = ½CV² ... (16.40)

book_ref.quote: Let us determine the electric potential energy stored in a charged capacitor graphically.

blocks.prompt:
20 A 5 μF capacitor is charged to 600 V. Find (i) the charge on it, (ii) the energy stored, and (iii) the energy stored if it is charged to 1200 V instead. (3 marks)
(5 μF capacitor 600 V tak charge hai. Nikalein: (i) us par charge, (ii) store energy, aur (iii) agar 1200 V tak charge kiya jaye to store energy.)
blocks.explanation: Q = CV aur W = ½CV² lagayein; W ∝ V², is liye V dugna karne se energy chaar guna.

book_ref.quote: If we put the value of Q = CV in eq. (16.39), we get

blocks.prompt:
21 Show that the energy of a charged parallel plate capacitor can be regarded as stored in the electric field between its plates, and derive the expression for the energy density of an electric field. (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke charged parallel plate capacitor ki energy ko plates ke darmiyan electric field mein store samjha ja sakta hai, aur electric field ki energy density ka formula derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Khayal: plates par charges ki potential energy ke bajaye energy ko plates ke darmiyan electric field mein store samjha ja sakta hai. Yeh nazariya tab mufeed hai jab plates ke darmiyan field ki taqat zair-e-ghaur ho.

Derivation: store energy W = ½CV² (16.40), yani P.E = ½CV² se shuru karein. Dielectric wale parallel plate capacitor ke liye:
C = Aε₀εᵣ/d aur uniform field ke liye V = Ed
Rakhne se:
Energy = ½(Aε₀εᵣ/d)(Ed)²
= ½ε₀εᵣE² × (Ad)
Yahan (Ad) plates ke darmiyan hajm (volume) hai. Is liye fi unit volume energy
Energy density = Energy/Volume = ½ε₀εᵣE² ... (16.42)

Matlab: energy density sirf field E aur medium par munhasir hai; yeh har electric field ke liye durust hai. Unit: J m⁻³.

book_ref.quote: It is also possible to regard the energy as being stored in electric field between the plates

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Eq. (16.41)' ka hawala deti hai jo maujood nahi (Book correction); asal substitution W = ½CV² (16.40) mein hoti hai. Yaad rakhein: ½CV² mein C aur V ko A, d aur E mein badlo, to Ad (volume) alag ho jata hai.

22 An air-filled parallel plate capacitor has plates of area 0.04 m² separated by 2 mm and is connected to a 500 V supply. Find (i) the electric field between the plates, (ii) the energy density, and (iii) the total energy stored between the plates. (Take ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²; εᵣ = 1 for air.) (3 marks)
(Hawa wale parallel plate capacitor ki plates ka area 0.04 m² aur faasla 2 mm hai; yeh 500 V supply se jura hai. Nikalein: (i) plates ke darmiyan electric field, (ii) energy density, aur (iii) plates ke darmiyan kul store energy. (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²; hawa ke liye εᵣ = 1.))

blocks.prompt:
23 With the help of an R-C circuit and graphs of charge against time, explain the charging and discharging of a capacitor. Define the time constant and show that the product RC has the unit of time. (5 marks)
(R-C circuit aur charge-waqt graphs ki madad se capacitor ka charge aur discharge hona samjhayein. Time constant ki definition likhein aur sabit karein ke RC ki unit waqt ki hai.)
blocks.explanation:
R-C circuit (Fig. 16.11): resistor R aur capacitor C, switch S ke saath.

Charging: S ko A par karne se R-C combination battery V₀ se jur jata hai jo R ke zariye capacitor ko charge karti hai. Capacitor foran charge nahi hota: t = 0 par q = 0 aur charge aahista aahista equilibrium qeemat q₀ = CV₀ tak barhta hai (Fig. 16.12). Kisi lamhe voltage V = q/C.

Discharging: S ko B par karne se (Fig. 16.13 a) left plate ka +q resistance se anti-clockwise guzar kar right plate ke −q ko neutral karta hai. t = 0 par q = CV₀ se discharge shuru ho kar charge aahista sifar tak girta hai (Fig. 16.13 b).

Time constant: capacitor kitni tezi se charge ya discharge ho, yeh RC par munhasir hai. RC ki unit waqt ki hai, is liye ise time constant τ = RC kehte hain; yeh woh waqt hai jis mein capacitor equilibrium charge q₀ ka 0.63 hissa jama kar leta hai. Chhota time constant: equilibrium jaldi; chhota RC: tez discharge.

RC ki unit: Ohm's law V = IR aur I = q/t se V = (q/t)R, yani R = Vt/q. q = CV se C = q/V.
RC = (Vt/q)(q/V) = t
Is liye 1 ohm × 1 farad = 1 second.

book_ref.quote: Many electric circuits consist of both capacitors and resistors.

blocks.prompt:
24 A 4 μF capacitor is charged through a 500 kΩ resistor from a 9 V battery. Find (i) the time constant, (ii) the equilibrium charge, and (iii) the charge and the voltage across the capacitor after one time constant. (3 marks)
(4 μF capacitor ko 500 kΩ resistor ke zariye 9 V battery se charge kiya jata hai. Nikalein: (i) time constant, (ii) equilibrium charge, aur (iii) aik time constant ke baad capacitor par charge aur voltage.)
blocks.explanation: τ = RC; aakhri charge q₀ = CV₀; aik time constant ke baad charge 0.63 q₀ aur V = q/C.

book_ref.quote: defined as the time required by the capacitor to deposit 0.63 times the equilibrium charge

blocks.prompt:
25 Write the exponential decay equation for the charge of a capacitor discharging through a resistor. Show that after one time constant the charge falls to about 0.37 Q₀, and derive the time t½ in which the charge falls to half its initial value. (5 marks)
(Resistor ke zariye discharge hote capacitor ke charge ki exponential decay equation likhein. Sabit karein ke aik time constant ke baad charge taqreeban 0.37 Q₀ reh jata hai, aur woh waqt t½ derive karein jis mein charge apni ibtidai qeemat ka aadha ho jata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Decay equation: discharge hote capacitor mein koi bhi quantity x (charge, voltage ya current) aise kam hoti hai:
x = x₀e^(−t/RC) ... (16.43)
yani Q = Q₀e^(−t/RC), V = V₀e^(−t/RC) aur I = I₀e^(−t/RC), jahan e ≈ 2.718 aur RC = τ time constant hai. Negative exponent batata hai ke quantity exponentially kam hoti hai: pehle tez, phir aahista.

Aik time constant ke baad: t = RC rakhein:
Q = Q₀e^(−RC/RC) = Q₀e⁻¹ = Q₀/2.718 = 0.37 Q₀
Yani time constant woh waqt hai jis mein ibtidai charge Q₀ taqreeban 0.37 Q₀ (37%) reh jata hai; voltage aur current bhi utna hi girte hain. Chhota τ tez response, bara τ aahista.

Half time: decay equation mein Q = ½Q₀ rakhein:
½Q₀ = Q₀e^(−t½/RC), yani ½ = e^(−t½/RC)
Natural logarithm ki definition se: ln(½) = −t½/RC
t½ = −(RC) ln(½) ... (16.44)
Ab ln(½) = ln 1 − ln 2 = 0 − ln 2 = −0.693 ≈ −0.69
t½ = −RC(−0.69)
t½ = 0.69 RC ... (16.45)
(Fig. 16.16: charge 0.69RC par ½Q₀ aur RC par 0.37Q₀ hota hai.)

book_ref.quote: If we put t = RC, we will get the quantity of charge remained after 1 time constant.

blocks.prompt:
27 Explain the use of capacitors in (i) electric fans and motors, (ii) a camera flashgun, (iii) refrigerators and air conditioners, and (iv) the medical field. (5 marks)
(Capacitors ka istemal samjhayein: (i) bijli ke pankhon aur motors mein, (ii) camera flashgun mein, (iii) fridge aur AC mein, aur (iv) tibbi shoabe mein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Pankhe aur motors: capacitor pankha motor ke starting se jura hota hai aur power on karne par charge hota hai. Yeh starting coil ke current ka phase running coil ke muqable badal deta hai, is liye dono coils ghoomti magnetic field banate hain jo motor ko starting torque deti hai aur pankha ghoomne lagta hai. (Yeh izafi power nahi deta.) Washing machine, blender, chopper, grinder aur paani ki motors mein bhi capacitor yahi kaam karta hai.

(ii) Flashgun: capacitor camera ki battery se charge hota hai. Shutter button dabane par yeh xenon gas wali flash tube se jur jata hai. Is ka tez discharge bara current deta hai jo xenon ko ionize karta hai aur tez roshni ka jhatka nikalta hai.

(iii) Fridge aur AC: in ke compressors single-phase motors istemal karte hain jo khud chalu hone mein mushkil mehsoos karti hain, is liye zyada capacitance wala start capacitor lagaya jata hai. Motor ke khaas raftaar par pohanchne par relay ise alag kar deta hai. Run capacitor jura rehta hai aur energy efficiency behtar karta hai. Capacitor aur resistor mil kar time delay circuit banate hain jo power supply ke chalu hone mein deri kar ke aale ko bijli ke utaar charhao se bachata hai.

(iv) Tibbi shoaba: capacitors cardiac arrest mein dil ko jaan bachane wale jhatke ki energy store karte hain; imaging machines (CT, MRI, X-ray, ultrasound) mein noise filter kar ke tasveer saaf karte hain; EEG aur ECG mein ghair zaroori signals filter karte hain.

Capacitors rectification (AC ko DC mein badalna) mein bhi aam istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Capacitors are used in various household appliances such as electric fans

28 The capacitor of a flashgun has a capacitance of 400 μF and is charged to 250 V. Find (i) the charge stored, (ii) the energy available for the flash, and (iii) the energy available if the capacitor is charged only to 125 V. (3 marks)
(Flashgun ke capacitor ki capacitance 400 μF hai aur yeh 250 V tak charge hai. Nikalein: (i) jama charge, (ii) flash ke liye dastiyab energy, aur (iii) agar capacitor sirf 125 V tak charge ho to dastiyab energy.)
blocks.explanation: Flash ko capacitor mein store energy milti hai: Q = CV aur W = ½CV²; V aadha karne se energy chautha hissa.

book_ref.quote: In a flashgun, a capacitor stores and releases electrical energy to power the flash tube.

steps: 125 V par: W′ = ½(400 × 10⁻⁶)(125)² = 3.125 J (12.5 J ka chautha hissa)
